question:
In the following question, out of the given four alternatives, select the alternative which best expresses the meaning of the Idiom/Phrase.

To put somebody to sword
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 2)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The phrase **"To put somebody to sword"** means t**o slay or execute someone. **(किसी को मार डालना या फांसी देना)

 
 
• **Example: **During the medieval wars, many prisoners were put to the sword.
 
 
 
• **"Slay or execute someone" **refers to killing someone deliberately. (किसी को जानबूझकर मारना)
 
 
• **Example: **The king ordered his soldiers** to slay the traitor.**
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: ***To slay or execute someone.***

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **To be well-informed or up-to-date **(अच्छी तरह से सूचित या अद्यतित होना): Having the latest information or knowledge.

 
 
• **Example:** She always reads the news **to stay well-informed about current events**.
 
 
 
• **To deceive someone **(किसी को धोखा देना): To mislead or trick someone.
 
 
• **Example: **He deceived his friend by hiding the truth about the deal.
 
 
 
• **To give challenge** (चुनौती देना): To invite someone to compete or fight.
 
 
• **Example:** He decided **to give a challenge** to his rival in the competition.
 
 

31:Tbd8,

The correct answer is **Option 3)**
